previous_bug: AbortSignal sent observer_cancel but a hung observer_read could remain pending until timeout; reproduced at approximately 2.3 seconds.
existing_fix: NativeReaderPipeProvider closes its read socket on abort, preserves an Error reason, cleans up the listener and sends observer_cancel at most once.
new_regression: An observer_read deliberately hangs until the client transport timeout, native observer_cancel occurs exactly once, and a second observation on the same provider succeeds.
